scope: federal, statewide, and legislative (State Senate and State House) only; no local, county, judicial retention, or ballot-issue contests

certification.note: The board met November 13, 2024 and certified the statewide abstract as the official State Canvass. The certification page is signed “this 13th day of November.” The official workbook also contains a “Statewide Senate Odd” sheet; odd-numbered Senate seats were not on the 2024 general ballot and that sheet was not used.
